notes: Single-stage: parse a three-source contact CSV, resolve duplicate (user,field,source) rows last-wins, detect per-user+field conflicts (>=2 distinct values), pick the priority winner (crm > billing > support), and emit a per-user conflict report whose total_conflicts matches the list length. Hidden cases probe three-way conflicts, duplicate resolution, agreement pairs, skipped malformed rows, blank lines, and a header-only file. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.
